categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Fuzzing label, modifies `src/test/fuzz/torcontrol.cpp` and test utility `src/test/util/net.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Substantially improves fuzz coverage of Tor control connection wire parsing while fixing a socket self-deletion bug in `DynSock::Wait()`. According to the PR description, line coverage of `src/torcontrol.cpp` increases from 52% to 81% by simulating a Tor daemon over a mock socket rather than invoking internal callbacks directly.
